explanation: Gift-giving is appreciated in Egyptian business and social settings as a gesture of goodwill, with quality chocolates or pastries as safe, well-regarded choices — but flowers are best avoided since they're associated with weddings or illness rather than casual gift-giving. Gifts should be given with the right hand or both hands, and avoiding alcohol or pork products is a safe default.
local_tip: Bring chocolates or pastries rather than flowers, and present the gift with your right hand.

also_check.note: Gift-giving is highly ritualized, with careful attention to wrapping and presentation.
Business gifts can seem inappropriate, especially if given before a deal is finalized.
Gift-giving is common, with the same right-hand presentation and alcohol/pork avoidance rules.

sources.title: Gift Giving Etiquette in the Middle East
